app_tagline: [ਪੰਜਾਬੀ] Speak your problem. We find your scheme.
consent_body: [ਪੰਜਾਬੀ] We collect only minimum details to match you with government schemes. Voice recordings are kept securely for 30 days and then automatically deleted. You can delete your data at any time from Settings.
mode_selection_title: [ਪੰਜਾਬੀ] How would you like to use Umeed?
mode_text_badge: [ਪੰਜਾਬੀ] For those who can read and type
mode_text_subtitle: [ਪੰਜਾਬੀ] Type your details in a familiar form.
mode_audio_prompt: [ਪੰਜਾਬੀ] Press the orange button to speak, or the blue button to type.
q_gender: [ਪੰਜਾਬੀ] Are you a woman, a man, or other?
q_state: [ਪੰਜਾਬੀ] Which state do you live in?
q_area: [ਪੰਜਾਬੀ] Do you live in a village or a city?
q_caste: [ਪੰਜਾਬੀ] Which category do you belong to? (General, OBC, SC, ST). You may skip this.
q_income: [ਪੰਜਾਬੀ] About how much does your family earn in a year?
q_occupation: [ਪੰਜਾਬੀ] What work do you do? (Farmer, student, laborer, homemaker, business, other)
q_disability: [ਪੰਜਾਬੀ] Do you have any disability? You may skip this.
q_family: [ਪੰਜਾਬੀ] How many people live in your family?
q_need: [ਪੰਜਾਬੀ] What kind of help do you need most? (Farming, education, health, housing, money, jobs)
caste_why: [ਪੰਜਾਬੀ] Certain government schemes provide special grants, subsidies, or reservations specifically for SC, ST, or OBC categories.
income_why: [ਪੰਜਾਬੀ] Many schemes are meant for families below specific income limits or BPL thresholds.
disability_why: [ਪੰਜਾਬੀ] Special pensions, assistive devices, and quotas exist for persons with disabilities.
handoff_title: [ਪੰਜਾਬੀ] Your recordings have reached a helper
handoff_desc: [ਪੰਜਾਬੀ] A trained civic helper is reviewing your voice responses to complete your profile.
busy_day_desc: [ਪੰਜਾਬੀ] Our helpers are currently busy. We have scheduled a confirmed callback slot for you tomorrow.
reminder_scheduled: [ਪੰਜਾਬੀ] We will send an SMS and notification 15 minutes before your slot.
profile_ready_notification: [ਪੰਜਾਬੀ] Your profile is ready! Tap to view your ranked schemes.
docs_locked_notice: [ਪੰਜਾਬੀ] Documents unlock after speaking to the Help Desk or choosing to skip.
skip_help_desk: [ਪੰਜਾਬੀ] I already understand, skip to documents
physical_office_address: [ਪੰਜਾਬੀ] Or visit nearby CSC / Gram Panchayat office
no_proxy_notice: [ਪੰਜਾਬੀ] Umeed does not submit applications on your behalf. We guide you to the official window.
delete_data_confirm: [ਪੰਜਾਬੀ] Are you sure? This will erase your profile and cached voice recordings immediately.
disclaimer: [ਪੰਜਾਬੀ] Disclaimer: Umeed is an informational and guidance tool. Final eligibility and approvals are decided solely by the respective government authority.
q_sector_focus: [pa] Which area or sector do you need help in? (Finance, Agriculture, Health, Housing, Education, Jobs, Pension)
choose_gist_language: [pa] In which language would you like your scheme summary and gist?
query_help_desk: [pa] Have a question about this scheme? Ask the Help Desk
type_query_hint: [pa] Type or speak your question for the helper...
